privacyPolicy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes what data may be processed when using the artem-d.dev website, the purposes for which it is used, and the rights that website visitors may have.

controller.title: 1. Who is responsible for data processing
paragraphs: The owner and operator of the artem-d.dev website is Artem D.
For questions related to privacy and the processing of personal data, you can contact me using the contact details provided on the website.

dataProcessed.title: 2. What data may be processed
paragraphs: The website does not require registration and currently does not provide forms for the direct collection of personal data.
dataProcessed.listIntro: When you visit the website, certain technical data may be processed automatically, including:
items: IP address;
browser type and version;
device type and operating system;
approximate location determined based on the IP address;
pages visited;
source from which you arrived at the website;
date and time of the visit;
data about interactions with the website.
dataProcessed.outro: This data may be processed using web analytics services.

googleAnalytics.title: 3. Google Analytics
paragraphs: The website uses Google Analytics, a web analytics service provided by Google.
Google Analytics is used to analyze website traffic, traffic sources, and how visitors interact with the website's pages.
For this purpose, Google Analytics may use cookies and similar technologies.
The data processed may include technical information about the device and browser, IP address, information about pages visited, traffic source, and interactions with the website.
Data processing by Google is carried out in accordance with Google's own terms and privacy policy.
Where applicable law requires user consent for the use of analytics technologies, Google Analytics is activated only after such consent has been obtained.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies and user choices
paragraphs: The website may use cookies and similar technologies.
Technologies necessary for the operation of the website may be used without additional consent where permitted by applicable law.
Optional technologies, including analytics cookies, are used after obtaining user consent where such consent is required.
The user's choice is stored in the browser.

The user may change a previously made choice at any time. To do so, use the “Reset privacy settings” link at the bottom of the website. After the reset, the website will ask the user to make a choice regarding the use of optional technologies again.

purposes.title: 5. Purposes of data processing
purposes.intro: Website usage data may be processed for the following purposes:
items: analyzing website traffic;
analyzing traffic sources;
understanding which pages and materials are most in demand;
analyzing how visitors interact with the website;
improving the structure, content, and operation of the website;
identifying technical issues.
purposes.outro: The data is not used for automated decision-making that produces legal or similarly significant effects for the user.

legalBasis.title: 6. Legal bases for processing
legalBasis.intro: Depending on the nature of the data and applicable law, processing may be carried out:
items: based on the user's consent;
to ensure the security and technical operation of the website;
based on a legitimate interest in maintaining and improving the website, where such a legal basis is permitted by law;
where processing is necessary to comply with legal requirements.
legalBasis.outro: Where processing is based on consent, the user may withdraw that consent at any time.

thirdParties.title: 7. Sharing data with third parties
paragraphs: Data may be shared with providers of technical services used for the operation of the website and analytics.
In particular, data may be processed by Google in connection with the use of Google Analytics.
Some service providers may process data outside the user's country of residence, including outside the European Economic Area.
In such cases, data processing and transfers are carried out using safeguards provided for by applicable law.

retention.title: 8. Data retention period
paragraphs: User-level and event-level data collected through Google Analytics is retained for 14 months in accordance with the Google Analytics settings.
After the relevant retention period expires, the data is deleted or is no longer available at the individual user and event level in accordance with Google Analytics rules.
Some aggregated statistical data may be retained for a longer period.

rights.title: 9. User rights
paragraphs: Depending on applicable law and the nature of the processing of personal data, the user may have the right to access, correct or delete their data, restrict processing, object to processing, and withdraw previously given consent.

To exercise these rights, the user may contact me using the contact details provided on the website. Each request is considered taking into account the nature of the data processed and the requirements of applicable law.

Because the website does not require registration and does not store user profiles, in some cases it may not be possible to link analytics data to a specific individual without additional information.

externalLinks.title: 10. Links to third-party websites and services
paragraphs: The website may contain links to third-party websites and services, such as Google Play.
When you follow a link to a third-party resource, data processing is governed by the privacy policy and terms of the relevant service.
I do not control the processing of data by third-party websites after the user leaves this website.

changes.title: 11. Changes to this Privacy Policy
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy may be updated due to changes in the website's functionality, the services used, or legal requirements.
The current version of the Policy is always published on this page.
If the website begins collecting additional personal data in the future, such as email addresses, this Privacy Policy will be updated before such processing begins.

privacy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy for the application Artem D Apps

general.title: 1. General Provisions
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy describes how data is processed when using the mobile application. The app is designed with local data storage in mind (offline-first). Financial records and other user-created app data are stored locally on the user's device and are not transferred to the developer.
The app may use third-party services for technical purposes, such as crash and error reporting. These services may process technical diagnostic data needed to detect, diagnose, and fix errors.

userData.title: 2.1 Data entered by the user
userData.intro: The user enters the following into the app:
items: financial records (transactions)
categories and tags
jar names, account names, notes, and other user settings
userData.outro: This data is stored locally on the user's device, is not transferred to the developer, is not copied to the developer's servers, and is not shared with third parties. The developer has no technical ability to access this data.

platformData.title: 2.2 Platform technical data
paragraphs: When installing and using the app, the Google Play platform may automatically process technical data such as device information, operating system version, diagnostic data, and crash reports.
Such data is processed by Google services in accordance with their own privacy policy. The developer does not receive the user's personal data from Google.

purchases.title: 2.3 In-app purchases
paragraphs: The app may use in-app purchases processed through Google Play. Payment processing is handled by Google's infrastructure. The developer does not receive bank card data, does not store payment information, and does not have access to the user's financial details.

crashes.title: 2.4 Crash and error reporting
paragraphs: The app uses Sentry, a third-party error monitoring service, to process crash reports and technical diagnostic data on behalf of the developer.

When an error occurs, the app may send technical diagnostic information to Sentry, such as crash logs, stack traces, app version, operating system version, device model, and other technical details related to the error.

Sentry is configured with default personal data collection disabled. The app does not intentionally send financial records, transaction data, jar names, tags, notes, account names, or other user-created financial content to Sentry.
The developer uses error reports only to improve app stability, diagnose technical issues, and fix bugs.
Because the app does not use accounts or assign user identifiers for error reporting, the developer may not be able to identify and delete a specific user's error reports.

storage.title: 3. Data storage
paragraphs: Financial records and other user-created app data are stored locally on the user's device in the app's database. Deleting the app results in deletion of locally stored data unless the user has created a backup beforehand. The developer does not store copies of this user-created app data and has no access to it.
Technical crash and diagnostic data may be processed by Sentry for error monitoring purposes.

thirdParties.title: 4. Transfer of data to third parties
paragraphs: The developer does not sell user data and does not transfer user-created financial data to third parties.
Financial records, transactions, tags, jar names, notes, settings, and backups are not transferred to the developer or to external servers by the app.
Technical crash and diagnostic data may be processed by Sentry on behalf of the developer for the purpose of detecting, diagnosing, and fixing errors.

backups.title: 5. Backups
paragraphs: If the app provides the ability to create a backup, the backup file is created by the user and saved at their discretion. The developer does not have access to backups.

rights.title: 6. User rights
items: delete locally stored app data by deleting the app or clearing the app data in device settings
opt out of using in-app purchases
contact the developer regarding privacy
rights.outro: Because the app does not use accounts or assign user identifiers for error reporting, the developer may not be able to identify and delete a specific user's error reports.

security.title: 7. Security
paragraphs: The app does not transmit the user's financial data over the internet. Technical crash and diagnostic data, if sent, is transmitted through a secure connection.
The user is responsible for the security of their device and any backups created.

changes.title: 8. Policy changes
paragraphs: An updated version of the policy is published on the app's official page.
